#### []{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.9m1ntcexhtuu style="padding-top:12pt;margin:0;color:#666666;padding-left:0;font-size:12pt;padding-bottom:0pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;height:12pt;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

### [Level 1: Show Weapon]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.8uqqum3w4208 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You have specialized in performing with a particular type of weapon.
Choose one type of melee weapon to designate as your Show Weapon. You
can use hands holding weapons designated as your Show Weapon to grapple
and shove[ as if they were free.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with another weapon
to change the kind of weapon you designate as your Show Weapon.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Some features that use your Show Weapon or Unarmed Strikes require your
target to make a saving throw. The save DC equals 8 plus your
Dexterity modifier[ and Proficiency
Bonus.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 1: Unarmored Defense]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.jo37cutzd3zk style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor
Class equals 10 plus your Strength and
Dexterity[ Modifiers.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 1: Weapon Mastery]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.59ow5k32qlrw style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of
two kinds of weapons of your choice[ with which you have proficiency,
such as Handaxes and
Mauls.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Whenever you finish a Long Rest[, you can change the kinds of weapons
you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties
of Scimitars and
Pikes.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 2: Fighting Style]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.l7sruwuccj2m style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see chapter
5).]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Whenever you gain an Acrobat level, you can replace the feat you chose
with a different Fighting Style
feat.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 2: Gymnastics]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.nzemkhbvwh5c style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You have trained in moving your body in ways that seem impossible to
others.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Glorious Vault.]{style="font-weight:700"} As a Bonus action while
you're standing, you can spend 10 feet of movement to jump a number of
feet equal to 5 times your Strength modifier to a point you can reach
within range. If the point you end your jump at is in the air, you fall
directly downwards to the ground.[ You do not need to move any distance
before making this jump.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Elegant Rebound. ]{style="font-weight:700"}When you have the
Prone[ condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of
movement.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Masterful
]{style="font-weight:700"}[Climbing]{style="font-weight:700"}[.]{style="font-weight:700;font-style:italic"}[ ]{style="font-weight:700"}You
gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 3: Acrobat Subclass]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.r74rvu1hypby style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You gain an Acrobat subclass of your choice. A subclass is a
specialization that grants you features at certain Acrobat levels. For
the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that
are of your Acrobat level or lower.

### [Level 3: Expertise]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.wyoyc3yem9uc style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
Athletics and Performance are recommended if you have proficiency in
them.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[At Acrobat level 7, you gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies
of your
choice.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 4: Ability Score Increase]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.1qnp0vmqfs3o style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your
choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Acrobat
levels 8, 10, 12, and
16.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 4: Graceful Tumbling]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.a7ngvt9nfqkh style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

When you take damage from falling, you only take half of the damage you
would normally take. Additionally, you can choose to land on your feet
instead of falling prone when you land.

### Level 5: Arrogant Display {#h.cxl6icwzmdxe style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Your shows have grown grander, and you won't fail to astound. As a Bonus
action, you may enter your Arrogant Display for a number of rounds equal
to your Performance modifier or until you become Incapacitated. Now and
at the start of each of your turns while your Arrogant Display is
active, you may choose to decrease your armor class by 1 until the start
of your next turn. If you do, attacks made with your Show Weapon and
unarmed strikes add both your Dexterity and Strength modifiers to their
damage rolls until the end of your current turn. Additionally, while
your Arrogant Display is active, your movement speed increases by a
number of feet equal to 5 times your Proficiency Bonus[.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

You can enter your Arrogant Display the number of times shown for your
Acrobat level in the Arrogant Display column of the Barbarian Features
table. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long
Rest.

### [Level 5: Extra Attack]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.v4j0m416ags7 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the
Attack[ action on your
turn.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 6: Brawling]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.4h5xezn8v2e3 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Once per turn, when you hit a target with your Show Weapon or an
Unarmed Strike, you can also perform one of the following actions with
the same attack. If you use your Show Weapon in this way, perform the
action as if you had performed an Unarmed Strike (see rules glossary).
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Grapple. ]{style="font-weight:700"}You attempt to grapple[ the target
if they're within 5 feet of you.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Shove. ]{style="font-weight:700"}You attempt to shove[ the
target.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Disarm]{style="font-weight:700"}[. ]{style="font-weight:700"}If your
target is holding a weapon or another object (such as a spellcasting
focus) you can attempt to disarm them of that item. Make a Strength
(Athletics) check contested by the target's Dexterity or Strength score
(whichever is higher). If your check equals or exceeds their ability
score, they drop the item they are holding.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Climb Enemy.]{style="font-weight:700"}[ ]{style="font-weight:700"}If
the enemy is at least one size larger than you, you can attempt to climb
it. Make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check contested by the target's
Strength score. If your roll equals or exceeds the target's ability
score you climb onto it. While climbing it, You have advantage on all
attacks made against the creature you are climbing, cannot push or pull
it, and are moved with it. The target can attempt to remove you at the
end of each of its turns by making a Strength (Athletics) contested by
your original Dexterity (Acrobatics) roll. If the target's roll equals
or exceeds your roll, you fall prone in an unoccupied space within 5
feet of the target. If the target teleports, or you are moved out of the
creature's space, you stop climbing it and land prone in an unoccupied
space.

### [Level 7: Evasion]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.j9g6llypc556 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you\'re
subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity [saving throw
to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on
the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can\'t use this
feature if you have the Incapacitated
condition.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 8: Bounding Leaps]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.kffnjongd4nm style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Whenever you use Glorious Vault, the maximum distance that you can jump
is increased by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Dexterity
modifier.

### Level 9: Stage Falling {#h.xqd2zfebffdt style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can use your Glorious Vault to slam into enemies. When you use your
Glorious Vault and choose to end your jump in another creature's space,
you can attempt to topple them over as part of the same Bonus Action.
The target must make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (it choses)
against your Show Weapon DC. On a failed save the target falls prone and
takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d10 + your Strength modifier/. After
they fall prone, you land in an unoccupied space of your choice within 5
feet of the target. On a successful save, you fall prone in an
unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of the target.

### [Level 10: Escape Artist]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.w7mpzozgounv style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain Thieves\' tools, and you have proficiency with them. You also
gain a Swim Speed equal to your Walking
Speed.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Additionally, whenever you are grappled or restrained, on your turn you
can spend 5 feet of movement to escape unless you are bound by magical
restraints.

### [Level 13: Greater Brawling]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.19ukmwwhgcqd style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Some of the options in your Brawling ability gain the following
benefits.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Grapple. ]{style="font-weight:700"}The target of your grapple is also
restrained until the grapple ends.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Shove. ]{style="font-weight:700"}The distance you shove the target
increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can choose to move them and
cause them to fall prone in the same attack. The creature rolls one save
for both effects.

### [Level 14: Grandiose Display]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.7phjzhfjkdg0 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

When you use your Arrogant Display, and at the start of each of your
turns while your Arrogant Display is active, when you decrease your
Armor Class you may choose to decrease your armor class again by 1 until
the end of your next turn. If you do, attacks [made with your Show
Weapon and unarmed strikes you deal this turn also deal an additional
1d10 damage. This additional damage is the same type as the Show weapon
used.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 17: Superior Brawling]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.pb0xdr1cnwzw style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain two more options that you can use when you use your Bawling
ability.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Twirl. ]{style="font-weight:700"}Once per turn, when you hit a target
with your Show Weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can make another attack
against a different creature within your reach. Use the same attack roll
against the second target, if the attack hits, use the same damage roll
that you used for the first target.

[Spin.]{style="font-weight:700"} Once per turn, when you hit a target
with your Show Weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can cause the target to
spin uncontrollably. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving
throw[ or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next
turn.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### Level 18: Defy Gravity {#h.9hf5l1crdf2x style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You are immune to damage from falling.

### [Level 19: Epic Boon]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.1a9wpyss8xw2 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you
qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.

### Level 20: Greatest Showman {#h.paja7x9rk830 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You have honed your muscles to even greater heights. Your Strength and
Dexterity[ scores increase by 2, to a maximum of 23.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Additionally[, when you roll initiative, you may automatically enter
your Arrogant Display without needing to spend a Bonus Action to do
so.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

## Killer Clown^[\[a\]](#cmnt1){#cmnt_ref1}^ {#h.e6a7z2r86pqn style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

### [Level 3: The Best Medicine]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.xbafonl4xjns style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

When you hit a target with a Show Weapon that you are wielding in two
hands, you can cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter without using a spell slot
as a Bonus action, targeting the creature that you hit with your weapon.
The spell save DC for this spell is your Show Weapon DC when you cast
this spell in this way. The Show Weapon must have the Two-Handed or
Versatile[ property to gain this benefit.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:8pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency
Bonus. You regain all expended uses after completing a Long Rest.

### Level 6: Sinister Smile {#h.bp3fllqi4c8 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

If you perform for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to seed paranoia
and fear into the minds of up to five humanoids who can hear your
performance. At the end of the performance, make a Charisma
(Intimidation) check and the targets must each [make a Wisdom (Insight)
check. If your roll equals or exceeds the target's, it is Frightened of
you for 1
hour.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Once you use this feature, you can\'t use it again until you finish a
Short Rest or Long Rest.

### Level 1[1: Unnerving Smash]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.1lvk5obpgj7a style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Attacks you make with a Show Weapon that you are wielding in two
hands deal an additional 1d8 psychic damage. Additionally, once per turn
when you deal psychic damage, you can strike terror into your target,
forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target
is frightened of you until the start of your next turn. The extra damage
from this ability is considered part of the weapon's damage dice.

### [Level 15: Feed on Fear]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.8czj8up9fnp1 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You can now use the terror you inflict to sustain and empower yourself.
At the start of your turn while your Arrogant Display is active you gain
one of the following benefits, choosing at the start of each turn. Each
option increases in power for each creature that is frightened of you or
under the effect of Tasha's Hideous Laughter, hereafter called your
"captive
audience".]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

        [Scared to Death. ]{style="font-weight:700"}[Your Show Weapon
attacks deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage for each captive audience
member until the end of your current
turn.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[The Show Must Go On. ]{style="font-weight:700"}[You regain 1d8 Hit
Points for each captive audience
member.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[Big Red Shoes. ]{style="font-weight:700"}Your walking speed increases
by 5 feet for each captive audience member.

## Firebreather {#h.ll2iiecxj0kb style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

### [Level 3: Fire Dance]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.4l87smjr22dx style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You have the [Produce Flame ]{style="font-style:italic"}and
[Elementalism ]{style="font-style:italic"}chantrips prepared and can
cast them without material components. When you cast [Elementalism
]{style="font-style:italic"}in this way, you can only control fire. Your
spellcasting ability for these spells is
Dexterity^[\[b\]](#cmnt2){#cmnt_ref2}^.

### Level 6: Flame's [Touch]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.9mdppplv9z85 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

While your Arrogant Display is active, attacks you make with a Show
Weapon that has the Finesse property to deal an additional 1d6 fire
damage. Additionally, when you take the attack action in your turn, you
can cast [Produce Flame ]{style="font-style:italic"}i[n place of one of
the attacks you make with that
action.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

The additional damage dealt this way increases to 2d6 at level 15.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 11: Heat Wave]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.yvgveng8uuwz style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can cast Fireball or Wall of Fire as a 4th-level spell without
spending a spell slot, using your Show Weapon DC. You can use this
feature twice, and regain all expended uses on a long rest.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Additionally you have Resistance to fire damage, Immunity to fire damage
dealt by your Firebreather abilities, and your Firebreather abilities
ignore Resistance to fire damage.

### Level 15: Blinding [Display]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.5ut90fxruyw2 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

When you activate your Arrogant Display all creatures of your choice
within 15 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed
save, a creature takes 4d10 fire damage and has the Blinded condition
for 1 minute. Creatures blinded in this way can repeat this save at the
end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. On a
successful save, a creature takes half damage only.

## Juggler {#h.h6z6elotchfj style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

### [Level 3: Combat Juggling]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.f9ausnv0p9dc style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

When you roll Initiative, you can immediately draw up to 5 Show Weapons
with the Thrown property and begin to juggle. Any Show Weapons that you
are juggling will ricochet back to your hands after being thrown at a
target (even if the attack
misses).^[\[c\]](#cmnt3){#cmnt_ref3}[\[d\]](#cmnt4){#cmnt_ref4}[\[e\]](#cmnt5){#cmnt_ref5}^

### [Level 6: Blade Waltz]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.row8fsj8ir9g style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Your juggling skills have gone beyond the mundane, allowing you to
cause knives to juggle themselves. When you hit a creature with a thrown
attack using a Show Weapon, you can immediately cast Cloud of Daggers
without spending a spell slot, centered on the creature you hit, and
your concentration can't be broken as a result of taking
damage.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency
bonus and regain all expended uses on a Long Rest.

### Level 11: Go For The Juggler {#h.8tbh7xpn6lj style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[While your Arrogant Display is active, you can draw or stow an
additional two weapons on each of your turns, and can juggle up to 10
Show Weapons at once.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Additionally while your Arrogant Display is active, you can perform an
Attack action, spending all attacks to throw all weapons you are
currently juggling, making an attack for each weapon against targets
within range. When you do, weapons do not benefit from Combat Juggling.

### [Level 15: Colossus Juggler]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.upbhw6todt3p style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

While your Arrogant Display is active, you enter a state of extreme
focus and strength. During this time, you're considered one size larger
for effects such as grappling, carrying capacity, and throwing.
Additionally, you can throw a creature you are grappling if it is your
size or smaller. You can throw a creature a number of feet equal to 5
times your proficiency modifier. When you do, treat the creature you
throw as a weapon with the thrown property that deals 1d6 damage to the
creature if it's Small or smaller, 2d6 if it\'s Medium, or 3d6 if it\'s
Large or larger. On a hit against another creature, both the
thrown creature and the target take the damage dealt this way.

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

### [Level 6: Beast Tamer]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.d0zcf7u06gtj style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can now quickly call upon a trained animal to aid in your act. You
can cast Summon Beast as a 2nd-level spell without spending a spell
slot, using Dexterity as the spell casting ability. You can use this
feature twice, and regain all expended uses on a long rest.

### [Level 11: Tandem Takedown]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"} {#h.jqhqqdzez6x5 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws made to resist or end your
Brawling ability[ as long as they are adjacent to one or more of your
allies.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

[]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:7pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}

Additionally, you can attempt to grapple creatures if they're up to 10
feet away from you and within reach of your Show Weapon.

### Level 15: Whip Cracking {#h.9udq0rny0eb6 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Arial\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

While your Arrogant Display is active, attacks you make with a Show
Weapon against a creature exactly 10 feet away from you deal an
additional 2d10[ damage of the weapon's damage type.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:\"Arial\";font-style:normal"}
